title: All Settings on an Agent Explained

cues.en: Hi and welcome to this AI and C-Sharp video on the Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎收看這支介紹 Microsoft Agent Framework 的 C# AI 影片。

cues.en: Today we are going to cover every single agent setting you can make on an agent in Agent Framework down to the very small bits of it.
cues.zh: 今天會介紹 Agent Framework 中，代理程式所有可以設定的選項，連細微的設定也會涵蓋。

cues.en: It will be a high level overview because a lot of these settings requires its own video which is already in the channel and some of them are very, very obscure.
cues.zh: 這是一個整體概覽，因為許多設定都需要獨立影片說明，頻道上也已經有相關影片；還有一些設定則非常少見。

cues.en: But I wanted to cover everything so you have an idea on what level of settings you can actually set.
cues.zh: 不過我想完整介紹，讓你了解究竟能調整哪些層級的設定。

cues.en: So let's jump into it.
cues.zh: 我們開始吧。

cues.en: There are four places you can configure your agents.
cues.zh: 總共有四個地方可以設定代理程式。

cues.en: You can configure it when you make your provider.
cues.zh: 第一個是建立供應商用戶端時。

cues.en: There is certain things that you can set like timeout and stuff like that. But not really.
cues.zh: 可以設定逾時等選項，但嚴格來說，

cues.en: It's for the calls, not the agent themselves.
cues.zh: 這些影響的是呼叫，不是代理程式本身。

cues.en: Then you have all the agent settings that you can set.
cues.zh: 接著是代理程式自己的設定。

cues.en: There's two overloads when you say as AI agent.
cues.zh: 呼叫 AsAIAgent 時，有兩種多載。

cues.en: And we'll cover every single thing that is possible to set there.
cues.zh: 我們會介紹其中所有可以設定的內容。

cues.en: Then we cover middleware where after our agent we can put some more configuration on it.
cues.zh: 再來是中介軟體，建立代理程式後，可以在外面加入額外設定。

cues.en: And finally there is, when we actually call the individual call, there is some additional settings that we can set.
cues.zh: 最後，實際執行單次呼叫時，也有一些額外選項。

cues.en: Not that they are too important, but they are there.
cues.zh: 它們不見得經常用到，但確實存在。

cues.en: At the end I will also show how all of this is done using Agent Framework Toolkit and it will explain a lot why I made that NuGet package to make this easier.
cues.zh: 最後也會示範如何透過 Agent Framework Toolkit 完成同樣的設定，讓你明白我為什麼建立這個 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: Because what you're about to see is a very, very deep dive down to a very big rabbit hole
cues.zh: 因為接下來會深入一個相當複雜的設定世界，

cues.en: of settings within settings within settings that can be intimidating if you need to do something advanced.
cues.zh: 選項裡還有選項，一層又一層；想做進階設定時，可能會有點嚇人。

cues.en: But let's get into it.
cues.zh: 我們開始看。

cues.en: So the provider settings, they are fairly simple in that you can make various different providers.
cues.zh: 供應商設定相對簡單，因為可以建立各種不同供應商的用戶端。

cues.en: Here I'm doing an Azure OpenAI client.
cues.zh: 這裡我建立 Azure OpenAI 用戶端。

cues.en: And in that we of course give the basics like endpoints and API keys.
cues.zh: 基本上當然需要端點與 API 金鑰。

cues.en: But then there is a client options where you can set things like timeouts, retries and so on.
cues.zh: 另外還有 ClientOptions，可以設定逾時、重試等選項。

cues.en: I won't go into every single one of them because they are different from each of the providers Azure, Entropic, Google and so on.
cues.zh: 我不會逐一介紹，因為 Azure、Anthropic、Google 等供應商的選項各不相同。

cues.en: Timeout is definitely one of the ones you will normally do if you have some very, very
cues.zh: 如果某些呼叫執行時間很長，

cues.en: long calls that takes more than the default timeout in .NET.
cues.zh: 超過 .NET 預設的逾時時間，通常就會需要設定 Timeout。

cues.en: Often you will also see that providers that are not the big frontier labs like Entropic
cues.zh: 你也常會看到，不屬於 Anthropic，

cues.en: and OpenAI, that they use the OpenAI client and then give the endpoint, for example, here to OpenRouter but could also be XAI and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 或 OpenAI 這類前沿模型公司的供應商，會沿用 OpenAI 用戶端，再指定端點；例如這裡的 OpenRouter，也可以是 xAI 等。

cues.en: So every single one of these options inside the providers have additional things but it's
cues.zh: 所以每個供應商的選項還有其他細節，

cues.en: mostly about retries, networks, endpoints and such like that.
cues.zh: 不過主要都是重試、網路、端點等設定。

cues.en: Moving up to the main part of this agent settings, we have options to make our agents from absolutely
cues.zh: 接著進入代理程式設定的主要部分：從完全不提供設定，

cues.en: no settings to endless amount of settings.
cues.zh: 到非常大量的設定都可以。

cues.en: So if we want to have an agent with no settings, the only real setting we need to set always is what model we are going to use.
cues.zh: 如果不想設定任何內容，實際上唯一一定要指定的，就是所用的模型。

cues.en: But if we do something like this, this will actually work.
cues.zh: 像這樣寫，確實就能執行。

cues.en: It will just use the stock, in this case GPT-56LUNA to have our agent and it will not answer in
cues.zh: 它會直接使用指定的預設模型來建立代理程式，

cues.en: a specific way, it will not have any tools available or anything.
cues.zh: 但不會有特定的回答風格，也沒有任何工具可用。

cues.en: And in the same manner, if we do it using responses API instead of chat client, we do more or less the same, but the model needs to be set on the ER agent instead of the responses client
cues.zh: 如果改用 Responses API，而不是 Chat Client，做法也差不多；只是模型要指定在代理程式上，而不是 Responses Client，

cues.en: itself. Small details.
cues.zh: 本身。這是個小差異。

cues.en: In real life, you will at least set model, instructions and tools.
cues.zh: 實際開發時，至少會設定模型、指示與工具。

cues.en: And that can be done fairly simple here.
cues.zh: 這裡的寫法很簡單。

cues.en: So you put the model in of course, you put your instructions which is your prompt engineering and you put in your tools that this agent should be allowed to call.
cues.zh: 指定模型，再提供指示，也就是提示詞工程的部分，最後加入允許這個代理程式呼叫的工具。

cues.en: So in some cases, you can have this as enough.
cues.zh: 有些情境下，這樣就已經足夠。

cues.en: I tend to also work a lot with reasoning efforts.
cues.zh: 我也很常調整推理強度。

cues.en: So there we need to go a bit deeper, and unfortunately that's not on this level one of the reasons why I also made my own, which we'll look at at the end.
cues.zh: 這就得再深入一層，因為這個層級沒有該設定；這也是我另外製作套件的原因之一，最後會示範。

cues.en: But for simple tests and things, these are probably the three most ones that you're going to use.
cues.zh: 但對簡單測試而言，這三個大概就是最常用的選項。

cues.en: But we need to be able to set more settings.
cues.zh: 不過我們仍然需要更多設定。

cues.en: And there are two options when you say as AI agent, you either get this with some parameters
cues.zh: 呼叫 AsAIAgent 時有兩種選擇：像這樣傳入數個參數，

cues.en: or there's a dedicated option object.
cues.zh: 或傳入專門的選項物件。

cues.en: I would say this one can't really be used for too much because as you can see, we can set our instruction tools just like we did.
cues.zh: 我認為參數版的用途比較有限，因為能設定的指示與工具，和剛才一樣。

cues.en: But beyond that, we can set a name, which is just display and description, which is also just display.
cues.zh: 此外可以設定 Name 與 Description，但主要都只是顯示資訊。

cues.en: So whenever an agent is called, you can get its name out if need be.
cues.zh: 例如代理程式被呼叫時，必要時可以取得它的名稱。

cues.en: There's something for client factory, which makes the iChat client to be changed.
cues.zh: 另外有 ClientFactory，可以改變底層的 IChatClient。

cues.en: I personally never use this.
cues.zh: 我個人從來不使用這個寫法。

cues.en: I use the option I'm going to show in one second.
cues.zh: 我會用等一下要介紹的選項物件。

cues.en: But here we can go in, for example, and set reasoning efforts.
cues.zh: 不過這裡確實可以設定，例如推理強度。

cues.en: I think it's a bit too difficult to set like this, but it is a possibility if you just want quick and dirty settings.
cues.zh: 我覺得這樣設有點麻煩，但如果只是快速設定，還是可以使用。

cues.en: But I don't really like this approach.
cues.zh: 只是我不太喜歡這種做法。

cues.en: Also if you want to set logging, you can do that.
cues.zh: 如果需要記錄 logging，也能在這裡設定。

cues.en: In here we've set a console log here with various logging.
cues.zh: 這裡設定主控台記錄與各種日誌選項。

cues.en: I would say OpenTelemetry is probably better than just custom logging, but it depends on what you need.
cues.zh: 我認為 OpenTelemetry 通常比自訂日誌更好，不過還是看你的需求。

cues.en: And there is a setting about sending in a service provider so you can do dependency injection in tools and other objects.
cues.zh: 另外可以傳入 ServiceProvider，讓工具與其他物件能使用相依性注入。

cues.en: I have a dedicated video for that, but essentially it's just if anything your agent is ever going
cues.zh: 我有另一支影片專門說明；基本上，就是代理程式將來會使用的任何東西，

cues.en: to use needs dependency injection for some reason, it is possible to send in your service provider.
cues.zh: 如果需要相依性注入，都可以透過傳入 ServiceProvider 來處理。

cues.en: This is not the one I'm really going to use, or when I use it, I use it like this with those three only.
cues.zh: 這個多載不是我主要使用的方式；即使使用，也通常只設定這三項。

cues.en: I don't really set anything beyond that here.
cues.zh: 不太會在這裡加入更多設定。

cues.en: But what we can do is we can use the chat client agent options.
cues.zh: 另一種做法，是使用 ChatClientAgentOptions。

cues.en: This is the second overload when we have SDR options and where we give a new options object in.
cues.zh: 這是 AsAIAgent 的第二個多載，傳入新建立的選項物件。

cues.en: This one has much more than what we have here, and I feel like it's always worth going
cues.zh: 它能設定的內容多得多；我認為除非需求非常簡單，

cues.en: that route unless you have the very, very simple stuff because then you can expand without needing to change.
cues.zh: 否則通常值得採用這條路，之後擴充時就不需要更換寫法。

cues.en: There's a bunch of options in here.
cues.zh: 這裡有很多選項。

cues.en: Some of them are very, very handy.
cues.zh: 有些非常實用。

cues.en: Some of them are very, very obscure that I, in my, let's say, it's now eight months or
cues.zh: 但也有些非常少見，像我使用 Agent Framework 大約八個月，

cues.en: ten months of using agent framework, I've never ever used.
cues.zh: 或十個月以來，都從未用過。

cues.en: But let's go through them.
cues.zh: 不過我們還是逐一看看。

cues.en: First up, you can give your agent an ID.
cues.zh: 首先，可以替代理程式指定 ID。

cues.en: If you need it to store in some way or anything, it's mostly for display, and if you don't give one, a GUI will automatically be assigned to it.
cues.zh: 如果需要儲存或識別代理程式，可以使用它；主要是識別用途，若未指定，會自動分配 GUID。

cues.en: But it is possible to give it an ID so you can reference it.
cues.zh: 你也可以自行提供 ID，之後就能用它參照代理程式。

cues.en: Same way you can give it a name.
cues.zh: 同樣地，也能指定名稱。

cues.en: Again, it's optional and display only, and a description, which is, again, no practical effects, only the description that you can bring up.
cues.zh: 這是選填的顯示資訊；Description 也一樣，沒有實際行為上的影響，只提供可取用的描述。

cues.en: Then there's something called AI context providers.
cues.zh: 接著是 AI Context Providers。

cues.en: This is a place where you can incept before and after LLM calls.
cues.zh: 它能在 LLM 呼叫前後攔截處理。

cues.en: I have deep dives into that in another video.
cues.zh: 另一支影片有深入介紹。

cues.en: But essentially you can go in, for example, and say, before the call, let me change what instructions should be there, what tools should be there, and after, extract what was set
cues.zh: 例如，呼叫前調整要提供的指示或工具；呼叫後擷取相關資訊，

cues.en: and turn it into memory and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 轉換成記憶等內容。

cues.en: But again, dedicated videos about AI context providers because else we would sit here even longer.
cues.zh: 不過 AI Context Providers 有專門的影片，否則這支影片會更長。

cues.en: The same goes for chat history provider, where we can use the in-memory chat history provider out of the box.
cues.zh: 對話歷程提供者也是一樣，預設就能使用記憶體中的對話歷程提供者。

cues.en: We don't need to set it.
cues.zh: 不需要另外設定。

cues.en: It will happen automatically, or it will make one of the providers that is from the underlying client.
cues.zh: 框架會自動建立，或使用底層用戶端提供的歷程儲存方式。

cues.en: For example, responses API have its own system for storing history.
cues.zh: 例如 Responses API 就有自己的歷程儲存機制。

cues.en: You can make your own, and you can go in and build custom ones that store it into other data stores and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 你也可以自訂提供者，把歷程儲存在其他資料儲存區。

cues.en: Again, I have a dedicated video on that.
cues.zh: 這部分同樣有專門的影片。

cues.en: One drawback when using the chat client agent options is that instructions and tools are actually in a sub-object called chat options.
cues.zh: 使用 ChatClientAgentOptions 的一個缺點，是 Instructions 與 Tools 實際上放在叫做 ChatOptions 的子物件中。

cues.en: So chat options is the underlying options from Microsoft Extensions AI, which Akan Framework is built upon.
cues.zh: ChatOptions 是底層 Microsoft.Extensions.AI 的選項，而 Agent Framework 就是建立在它之上。

cues.en: And in order to set them when we use this one, we actually need to new up this new chat options.
cues.zh: 因此，使用這個多載來設定時，還必須另外建立 ChatOptions。

cues.en: It's really annoying that these are not out here, so it could have been easier, but that's the way it is.
cues.zh: 如果能把這些常用選項放在外層會簡單得多，但目前就是這個設計。

cues.en: This chat options have a lot of other options, so many, in fact, that couldn't fit on this screen, so I will show them in the next screen.
cues.zh: ChatOptions 還有很多其他選項，多到這個畫面放不下，所以會在下一個畫面介紹。

cues.en: Beyond that, there's a bunch of obscure settings.
cues.zh: 除此之外，還有一批比較少見的設定。

cues.en: And to show that fact, exactly one of this, this one here, has this entire description
cues.zh: 例如這一項，單單一個選項，就需要這麼長的一段說明，

cues.en: on how it works, what it's about, and so on.
cues.zh: 解釋它的運作方式與用途。

cues.en: These are so niche that I have never, ever had a use for them.
cues.zh: 這些需求都很特殊，我自己從來沒有用過。

cues.en: But it's mostly around the chat history manipulation, if we need to clear it, if the provider also
cues.zh: 大部分都與對話歷程的處理有關，例如是否清除歷程、供應商本身，

cues.en: have a chat history, should it warn if there's multiple, should message injections happen into chat history, and so on.
cues.zh: 也有歷程時該怎麼辦、多個歷程來源是否警告，以及注入訊息是否應放進對話歷程等。

cues.en: I would say if you, these are only things you will end up setting if you log an issue
cues.zh: 我認為，通常只有在 GitHub 儲存庫提出問題後，

cues.en: on their GitHub repo, and the team comes back and say, for your specific scenario, you need to do this, this, and this, and set this to true, and this to true.
cues.zh: 團隊針對你的特殊情境回覆，要求你把某些選項設為 true，才會需要調整。

cues.en: In real life, you're probably never gonna use these, unless you have a very, very obscure scenario that you need to set.
cues.zh: 一般應用幾乎不會用到，除非你的情境真的非常特殊。

cues.en: So don't bother too much about these.
cues.zh: 所以不用太擔心這些選項。

cues.en: If you need them, you will know already what they are about.
cues.zh: 等到真的需要時，你自然就會知道它們的用途。

cues.en: Beyond that, for some reason, these three extra settings that we also had on the previous
cues.zh: 另外，不知道為什麼，前一個多載出現的三個額外設定，

cues.en: one over here, client factory, logger factory, and services, also in this one, which is kind
cues.zh: 也就是 ClientFactory、LoggerFactory 與 Services，這個多載也一樣提供，

cues.en: of strange, because this one affects this one, and there's a bunch of things that makes it a bit different, because it's on various different levels of options.
cues.zh: 這有點奇怪，因為它們會影響內層的設定，卻又分散在不同的選項層級。

cues.en: But they work exactly the same, so we won't go into details.
cues.zh: 不過作用完全相同，所以不再深入。

cues.en: I would have liked if these were inside the chat agent options, but that's just the way it is.
cues.zh: 我會比較希望它們放在 ChatClientAgentOptions 裡，但目前就是如此。

cues.en: Again, you rarely set them.
cues.zh: 而且，這些選項也很少會設定。

cues.en: I promise that underneath this, we have the chat options.
cues.zh: 剛才提過，裡面還有一層 ChatOptions。

cues.en: So let's go in and see what Dakin sets.
cues.zh: 接著看看它能設定什麼。

cues.en: And Dakin sets a bunch of options itself as well.
cues.zh: 它本身也提供相當多選項。

cues.en: So we're really going down the rabbit hole now.
cues.zh: 現在真的越挖越深了。

cues.en: So I've mentioned the instructions are here, the tools are here, and fairly recently, an
cues.zh: 前面說過，Instructions 與 Tools 都在這裡，而最近，

cues.en: abstraction of reasoning has also come here.
cues.zh: 也加入了推理選項的抽象層。

cues.en: This has not really become a standard yet.
cues.zh: 不過這部分還沒有完全標準化。

cues.en: The Frontier LLMs, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, are slowly getting into that it needs reasoning
cues.zh: Anthropic、OpenAI、Google 等前沿模型供應商，正逐漸收斂到推理強度，

cues.en: effort, low, high, medium, and so on, and what kind of reasoning output that should be.
cues.zh: 例如 Low、High、Medium 等，以及應該提供何種推理輸出。

cues.en: So Microsoft Extension AI, which is providing this, have built an abstraction on top of
cues.zh: 所以提供這些選項的 Microsoft.Extensions.AI，就在上面建立了一層抽象，

cues.en: it, but I don't really trust it yet, and for example, there's not a max level of effort, which some of them can do and others cannot.
cues.zh: 但我目前還不太放心；例如沒有 Max 這個推理強度，有些模型支援，有些則不支援。

cues.en: So I tend to do this in the provider-specific settings that we will come to in one bit.
cues.zh: 因此我通常會直接使用稍後介紹的供應商專屬設定。

cues.en: But it is possible to get it a little further out now instead of needing to go even one layer deeper in order to set reasoning effort.
cues.zh: 不過現在確實可以在比較外層設定推理強度，不必再深入一層。

cues.en: Then there's some rare and often provider-specific things, like for example, max output tokens.
cues.zh: 接著是一些少見、而且通常與供應商有關的選項，例如 MaxOutputTokens。

cues.en: Max output tokens is something Anthropic models need, but none of the others need it by default.
cues.zh: Anthropic 模型需要指定最大輸出 Token，但其他供應商預設通常不需要。

cues.en: But it is possible to say, this is as many tokens as you are allowed to provide me when you give your response back.
cues.zh: 你可以用它限制模型回覆時最多輸出多少 Token。

cues.en: So it is a standard, but only Anthropic is required as default, else the others just go to, I can use whatever.
cues.zh: 它是標準選項，不過預設只有 Anthropic 強制要求；其他模型通常會自行決定。

cues.en: In a similar manner, if the underlying system that you have built have never asked for the
cues.zh: 同樣地，如果你前面建立的底層系統，

cues.en: model, it is possible in chat options to finally give the model here.
cues.zh: 一直沒有要求指定模型，也可以到 ChatOptions 才設定 Model。

cues.en: It is sometimes needed with Anthropic, but others give it up front, so often that's something you need to do.
cues.zh: Anthropic 有時會需要這樣做，其他用戶端通常是在更前面指定模型。

cues.en: Then we have response formats, which is tied to structured output.
cues.zh: 然後是 ResponseFormat，與結構化輸出有關。

cues.en: If you don't know structured output, you should definitely see those videos about that.
cues.zh: 如果還不了解結構化輸出，建議先看相關影片。

cues.en: But I've still put it in rare here, because this is where you go in and tweak the response format.
cues.zh: 不過我仍把這個選項列為少用，因為這是直接調整回覆格式的地方。

cues.en: You specify a schema for the structured output yourself in a more custom manner.
cues.zh: 你可以自行提供 schema，更細緻地控制結構化輸出。

cues.en: We don't really need to do that in Agent Framework, because we have to run async generic version, which on the fly builds this response format up for us.
cues.zh: 但在 Agent Framework 中通常不需要，因為泛型版 RunAsync 會自動替我們建立回覆格式。

cues.en: But if you need it for some reason to build some very, very advanced response way, and
cues.zh: 如果有特殊需求，要建立非常進階的回覆格式，

cues.en: you can't for some reason run async, it is possible to use the response format here.
cues.zh: 而且不方便使用泛型 RunAsync，仍可以透過這裡的 ResponseFormat 設定。

cues.en: The final one I put in rare is tool mode.
cues.zh: 最後一個列為少用的選項是 ToolMode。

cues.en: Tool mode is where you can actually control how the LEM is being structured, or what it must do with tools.
cues.zh: 它能控制 LLM 應該如何使用工具。

cues.en: The default is auto, meaning that it's allowed to either call the tool or not, depending if it feels it's okay or it needs to.
cues.zh: 預設是 Auto，也就是由模型自行判斷要不要呼叫工具。

cues.en: You can set it to disallow, but then you could argue you just don't give it tools, so you don't really need that as well.
cues.zh: 也可以設為不允許使用工具，但通常乾脆不要提供工具就好了。

cues.en: And finally, you can go in and say it needs to at least call one tool every time it calls, which is again also a kind of odd setting.
cues.zh: 最後還可以要求每次至少呼叫一個工具，這同樣是比較特殊的設定。

cues.en: So it's very, very rare that you want to do this.
cues.zh: 所以實際上很少需要這樣設定。

cues.en: It should probably be some setting that you say, but this time don't use tools or something like that.
cues.zh: 比較可能的用途，是某次呼叫特別要求不要使用工具。

cues.en: Then there's some obscure ones, like allow multiple tool calls at the same time.
cues.zh: 還有一些更少見的設定，例如允許同時呼叫多個工具。

cues.en: Normally when a LEM comes back, it only says, I want to use this tool, and it goes back and then will ask for another tool and so on.
cues.zh: 一般模型會先說要使用某個工具，取得結果後，再要求下一個工具。

cues.en: But you can say true, that it's allowed to do that.
cues.zh: 你可以把這項設為 true，允許一次提出多個工具呼叫。

cues.en: I have not seen any of the models actually do it in real life, so I don't think it's
cues.zh: 我自己還沒在實際使用時看過模型這麼做，所以我不認為，

cues.en: kind of normal to do, but you can control if it should be allowed or not for some reason.
cues.zh: 這是很常見的行為，但有需要時仍可控制是否允許。

cues.en: And there's two options for allowed background responses and continue token.
cues.zh: 另外還有 AllowBackgroundResponses 與 ContinuationToken。

cues.en: I have a dedicated videos about these two, but it's about if you have a LEM call that
cues.zh: 這兩項也有專門的影片；主要是在 LLM 呼叫，

cues.en: takes lots and lots of time, you can actually defer the call, say, go work on this, and
cues.zh: 需要很長時間時，可以先把工作交出去，讓它在背景執行，

cues.en: then I can sit on Paul to say, is it done yet? Is it done yet? And so on.
cues.zh: 然後由我們持續輪詢，詢問是否已經完成。

cues.en: Again, I have a dedicated video on it.
cues.zh: 相關內容在另一支影片中介紹。

cues.en: Then a bunch of settings I normally don't use.
cues.zh: 再來還有一些我平常不太用的設定。

cues.en: Additional properties, for example.
cues.zh: 例如 AdditionalProperties。

cues.en: Additional properties is described as, if the LEM needs this, you can send this as well in a key value store.
cues.zh: 它的說明是，如果 LLM 需要其他參數，就能透過這個鍵值集合一併提供。

cues.en: But in real life, it tends to not be in that structure anyway.
cues.zh: 但實際上，供應商需要的資料通常不會符合這個結構。

cues.en: And I have never ever seen some of these.
cues.zh: 有些選項我根本沒有看過實際用途。

cues.en: I've tried various options, figured out that it didn't work, and so it's not the solution most of the time.
cues.zh: 我曾經嘗試不同設定，結果沒有作用，因此多數情況它不是正確的做法。

cues.en: It's more this raw representation factory down here.
cues.zh: 通常應該改用下方的 RawRepresentationFactory。

cues.en: But you can try to set them, but I have never seen any real value in it.
cues.zh: 你當然可以試著設定，但我自己沒有從中得到什麼實際價值。

cues.en: And there's the conversation ID.
cues.zh: 另外是 ConversationId。

cues.en: You could argue that it might be up in rare and not obscure.
cues.zh: 這項也許應該列為少用，而不是極少見。

cues.en: But you can get the ID of the conversation, and then you can have the LLM continue the conversation if you give a previous conversation ID.
cues.zh: 你可以取得對話 ID，之後提供先前的對話 ID，讓 LLM 繼續同一段對話。

cues.en: For that, we will normally use the chat history in Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 不過在 Agent Framework 中，我們通常會使用對話歷程機制。

cues.en: And there's seed and stuff, a sequence which I have never used any of those two.
cues.zh: 還有 Seed 與 StopSequences，這兩項我也從來沒用過。

cues.en: Seeds should, if you know seeds from games and other things, so things are repeatable.
cues.zh: 如果你玩過遊戲或接觸過亂數種子，就知道 Seed 是為了讓結果可重現。

cues.en: So it's like mat.random, where you can put in a seed, so it will give reproducible results.
cues.zh: 類似亂數產生器，指定種子後就能得到可重現的結果。

cues.en: But if you read closer on seed, it's actually not guaranteed because we are dealing with LLMs here.
cues.zh: 但仔細看 Seed 的說明，就會發現這裡不保證完全一致，因為我們面對的是 LLM。

cues.en: But it will try as much as possible to give reproducible results, but in real life it's not really happening.
cues.zh: 它會盡可能讓結果可重現，但實務上未必做得到。

cues.en: Stop sequence is all about you can set in a list of words that should stop any processing.
cues.zh: StopSequences 則可指定一組文字，模型遇到這些文字就停止輸出。

cues.en: I can't really see why you would ever do that, but it is there.
cues.zh: 我不太能想到會在什麼情況需要，不過這個選項確實存在。

cues.en: Then you can see there's five settings here, all being of type float.
cues.zh: 接著可以看到五個浮點數型別的設定。

cues.en: I call them old settings now, because these are, classic one was temperature, where you
cues.zh: 我現在把它們稱為舊式設定；最典型的是 Temperature，

cues.en: set temperature to zero to get more reliable responses.
cues.zh: 過去會把它設成零，希望得到更穩定的回覆。

cues.en: But it's all about non-reasoning LLMs.
cues.zh: 但這些主要是為非推理型 LLM 設計的。

cues.en: And nowadays, none of the LLMs are non-reasoning, everyone is a reasoning model now.
cues.zh: 如今新模型大多都有推理能力。

cues.en: So things like trying to manipulate these often result in an exception from the model, depending on which one you call, or just being ignored.
cues.zh: 所以調整這些參數時，某些模型會直接拋出例外，有些則只是忽略。

cues.en: So I don't see in any way you need to set any of these.
cues.zh: 因此我認為通常不需要設定這些選項。

cues.en: The final one is something called Raw Representation Factory.
cues.zh: 最後是 RawRepresentationFactory。

cues.en: And Raw Representation Factory is just an object here, where you can give the provider
cues.zh: 它是一個工廠函式，讓你提供供應商，

cues.en: level settings that you need for, for example, Google or OpenAI and so on.
cues.zh: 原生層級的設定，例如 Google、OpenAI 等各自的選項。

cues.en: So this is where you set all the other settings that are not yet standard in AI.
cues.zh: 也就是在這裡設定尚未成為 AI 共通標準的參數。

cues.en: Caching was one of the big ones in the past, again, slowly getting into a standard.
cues.zh: 過去快取就是其中一大類，不過現在也正逐漸標準化。

cues.en: But service tiers, caching modes and stuff like that, you haven't seen here, and that's
cues.zh: 你前面沒有看到 ServiceTier、快取模式等選項，

cues.en: because you need to set them on a per provider level.
cues.zh: 就是因為它們必須透過各供應商的專屬設定來指定。

cues.en: So we need to go one step deeper into the rabbit hole.
cues.zh: 所以又得往設定世界的更深一層走。

cues.en: And that is the Raw Representation Factory.
cues.zh: 這一層就是 RawRepresentationFactory。

cues.en: So for example, if we use OpenAI's responses API, we can set the response Raw Representation Factory to a great response options, where we can then begin to set the reasoning options
cues.zh: 例如使用 OpenAI Responses API 時，可以讓 RawRepresentationFactory 回傳 CreateResponseOptions，再設定 ReasoningOptions，

cues.en: and service tiers and so on, and so forth.
cues.zh: 以及 ServiceTier 等內容。

cues.en: If we go chat client, it's a different object, so you can see Raw Representation Factory is different objects from time to time.
cues.zh: 如果使用 Chat Client，對應的物件就不同，因此 RawRepresentationFactory 回傳的型別並不固定。

cues.en: So there's different ways of setting them, Gemini have a different way where it's a generate
cues.zh: 各供應商的設定方式也不一樣；Gemini 使用 GenerateContentConfig，

cues.en: content config with thinking config, and Entropiq have a message creation params where you need to set the thinking params and so on.
cues.zh: 搭配 ThinkingConfig，而 Anthropic 則使用 MessageCreateParams，再設定 Thinking 參數等內容。

cues.en: So whenever you end up with something that you can't find, it's probably down in a Raw
cues.zh: 所以，如果某個設定怎麼找都找不到，通常就要到 RawRepresentationFactory，

cues.en: Representation Factory here in order to set the various options that are provider specific.
cues.zh: 裡面設定供應商專屬的選項。

cues.en: So these objects here, they are directly from the NuGet package of Entropiq, Google, and
cues.zh: 這些物件直接來自 Anthropic、Google 等供應商的 NuGet 套件，

cues.en: so on, and not part of Agent Factory itself, but it can take that and serialize it and
cues.zh: 不是 Agent Framework 本身的型別；框架只負責接收、序列化，

cues.en: put it on into the code on the fly.
cues.zh: 並在執行時把它們交給底層使用。

cues.en: Moving on to middleware, we won't go into middleware too much, but middleware is when
cues.zh: 接著是中介軟體，這裡不會太深入；前面都只是定義代理程式，

cues.en: we have our agent, before now we had only defined our agent, but now we have our agent,
cues.zh: 而現在已經有代理程式物件了，

cues.en: and we can say as builder, and then use various different things until we build.
cues.zh: 就能呼叫 AsBuilder，串接各種功能，最後再 Build。

cues.en: So it's a little like normal service providers when we build our app and say use authentication,
cues.zh: 這有點像一般應用程式建立服務時，呼叫 UseAuthentication，

cues.en: use authorization, and so on, but it's just for the agent.
cues.zh: 或 UseAuthorization，只不過這裡是用在代理程式上。

cues.en: So we can go in, for example, and have various .use, so they have 5-6 overloads on this.
cues.zh: 例如可以串接各種 Use 方法，這裡大約有五、六種多載。

cues.en: The one you probably want to use is tool calling middleware, so you can actually make
cues.zh: 你比較可能需要的是工具呼叫中介軟體，可以寫一個，

cues.en: a small middleware method here in order to grab details about what tool is about to be called or stop the tool.
cues.zh: 小型方法，攔截即將執行的工具資訊，或阻止工具呼叫。

cues.en: Again, dedicated video on how to do that.
cues.zh: 這部分同樣有專門的影片。

cues.en: You can also use other versions of this, mostly they are covered by context providers instead.
cues.zh: 也有其他中介軟體版本，不過多數需求都能改由 Context Provider 處理。

cues.en: Because the AI context providers can also be defined here, but only message-based AI
cues.zh: 因為 AI Context Provider 也可以在這裡加入，但只支援訊息型的，

cues.en: context providers, again, covered in the AI context providers deep dive video itself, but
cues.zh: AI Context Provider。相關細節會在深入介紹的影片說明，

cues.en: essentially you can go in and say, on the fly, add some message injection to your system,
cues.zh: 基本上就是在執行時注入額外訊息，

cues.en: more messages for an LLM to know, rack information, and so on, and so forth.
cues.zh: 讓 LLM 取得更多資訊，例如 RAG 的檢索結果等。

cues.en: For some reason, you can also define the logging here, which you could already in the definition, but you can also put it after the fact here.
cues.zh: 不知道為什麼，這裡也能加入 logging；前面定義時已經能設，但事後仍可再次設定。

cues.en: I guess it's because you can make generic agents and then put different logging into each one of them, if need be.
cues.zh: 我猜是為了讓共用的代理程式，能依需求加入不同的記錄方式。

cues.en: So here you define OpenTelemetry, I have a dedicated video on that.
cues.zh: OpenTelemetry 就在這裡設定，另一支影片有專門介紹。

cues.en: And they also have things for tool approval, so, for example, if you have tool approval where the user needs to say, I approve this tool, I reject this tool, and so on, you often
cues.zh: 還有工具核准機制，例如使用者必須選擇允許或拒絕工具呼叫，

cues.en: also want something to, I approve this tool and don't ask me again, this middleware helps keep track of such things.
cues.zh: 通常也需要「允許這個工具，以後不要再詢問」的選項；這個中介軟體可以協助記錄這些決定。

cues.en: I tend to let an LLM call the tools without any approval, so I haven't really used it
cues.zh: 我通常讓 LLM 直接呼叫工具，不另外要求核准，所以自己沒有，

cues.en: too much, but it's there if you need it.
cues.zh: 大量使用這項功能，但需要時可以使用。

cues.en: You can also build your own middleware.
cues.zh: 你也可以自行建立中介軟體。

cues.en: It's just an object with an extension method on, if you need to do something special in
cues.zh: 本質上只是附帶擴充方法的物件；如果代理程式有特殊需求，

cues.en: your agent, apply name and description or whatever you want.
cues.zh: 例如套用名稱、描述，或其他任何處理，都能自行實作。

cues.en: Then we have the call itself, and I know this is getting long, but luckily the call, while
cues.zh: 接著是呼叫本身。我知道影片已經有點長，不過幸好這部分，

cues.en: it looks menacing, you have 18 different overloads when you do run async.
cues.zh: 雖然看起來很複雜，RunAsync 有十八種多載，

cues.en: It's mostly about how the different messages are being sent.
cues.zh: 但主要差異只是訊息的傳入方式。

cues.en: The message being sent as a string, is it sent as a chat message, is it sent as a list
cues.zh: 例如訊息以字串、ChatMessage，或 ChatMessage 清單，

cues.en: of chat messages, or is it even sent because the session takes care of it.
cues.zh: 傳入；甚至不傳入訊息，讓 session 自行處理。

cues.en: There is options for serialization and options for extra options here, but what we will see is that in essence, it's very, very simple.
cues.zh: 此外也有序列化與額外選項的設定，不過本質上相當簡單。

cues.en: You send your message or one of the overloads with either just a string, a chat message.
cues.zh: 可以用其中一種多載，傳入一般字串或 ChatMessage。

cues.en: Chat message is a good way of doing it if you need images and PDFs because it can have
cues.zh: 如果需要圖片或 PDF，ChatMessage 很適合，因為它能包含，

cues.en: additional content or a list of messages if you don't want to use agent sessions, meaning previous turn conversation.
cues.zh: 額外的 Content；如果不想使用代理程式 session 追蹤前幾輪對話，也可以傳入訊息清單。

cues.en: So you can either use the agent session, which is the chat history, or you can just send the entire conversation as a list of messages.
cues.zh: 因此可以使用代理程式 session，也就是對話歷程；或自行把完整對話當作訊息清單傳入。

cues.en: Then the user said this, then the agent said this, then the user said this.
cues.zh: 例如使用者先說什麼、代理程式回覆什麼、使用者又說什麼。

cues.en: So you don't need to use sessions in order to have a continued conversation, but it is possible.
cues.zh: 所以延續對話不一定要使用 session，這兩種方式都做得到。

cues.en: And then we have the options, but luckily for us, all of these settings are exactly the same as what is on the agent.
cues.zh: 然後是呼叫選項。幸好，這些設定其實與代理程式上的選項完全相同。

cues.en: So if you define them on the agent, it means every single call will do it, but there could be scenarios where on a specific call, you don't want to use a specific setting.
cues.zh: 如果設在代理程式上，每次呼叫都會使用；但也有些情況，某一次呼叫不想沿用某個設定。

cues.en: So it is possible to again change the chat options, the client factory, and they are put out
cues.zh: 因此可以再次改變 ChatOptions 或 ClientFactory；另外這幾項也被拉到外層，

cues.en: because these make fairly much sense on the call itself to allow the background responses and continue.
cues.zh: 因為允許背景回應與接續回應，確實比較適合針對單次呼叫來設定。

cues.en: So it is possible to set all these settings.
cues.zh: 所以這些選項都能在呼叫時指定。

cues.en: In real life, you often don't do this because you just make different agents to do different ways of calling, and those agents will do the same every single time.
cues.zh: 實務上通常不會這樣做，而是建立不同的代理程式，各自使用固定的呼叫設定。

cues.en: But it is possible to override most of the settings on the individual call level if need be.
cues.zh: 不過必要時，大部分設定都可以在單次呼叫層級覆寫。

cues.en: That is all the settings, and as you can see, there's a lot of them, and they are in various different levels that you need to set.
cues.zh: 以上就是所有設定。可以看到數量很多，而且分散在不同層級。

cues.en: And for that reason, which annoyed me a lot in the beginning, it has become slightly better, but it's still setting within setting within setting.
cues.zh: 這點一開始讓我很困擾；雖然現在稍有改善，但仍然是選項裡面還有選項。

cues.en: I think you can get four levels deep or something like that.
cues.zh: 我想最深大概可以到四層。

cues.en: So for that reason, I built Agent Framework Toolkit, which I have other videos about, but essentially it's just a NuGet package that are more opinionated.
cues.zh: 所以我建立了 Agent Framework Toolkit，其他影片有介紹；基本上，它是一個採用較明確設計取向的 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: So you go in and make a factory, which is an Azure OpenAI factory or an OpenAI factory or a Gemini factory and so on.
cues.zh: 先建立 Factory，例如 AzureOpenAIFactory、OpenAIFactory 或 GeminiFactory。

cues.en: And once you have one of those, you get Create Agent, which has a set of options.
cues.zh: 有了 Factory，就能呼叫 CreateAgent，傳入一組選項。

cues.en: And here, all options, as we've just seen, is here.
cues.zh: 剛才介紹的所有設定，都集中在這裡。

cues.en: You can set every single one of them, but they have been weaved into a single options object.
cues.zh: 每一項都能設定，只是全部整理成單一選項物件。

cues.en: So no options within options within options.
cues.zh: 不再需要一層又一層地找選項。

cues.en: Everything is joined in here, including the middleware that will on the fly apply to you.
cues.zh: 全部都集中在這裡，連中介軟體也會自動套用。

cues.en: So you have only what makes sense for Azure OpenAI, only what makes sense for Google and so on.
cues.zh: 而且 Azure OpenAI、Google 等供應商只會看到各自適用的選項。

cues.en: So service tier is here directly for OpenAI because we are an Azure and OpenAI agent.
cues.zh: 例如這裡建立的是 Azure OpenAI 或 OpenAI 代理程式，就能直接設定 ServiceTier。

cues.en: For Entropic, it will require the max output tokens, which you else need to go in and set
